name: Plural Industry Holding Group Co. Limited
summary: Plural Industry Holding Group Co. Limited, a development stage company, focuses on developing and operating Internet domain names in the budget travel and related categories. The company was formerly known as Enabling Asia, Inc. and changed its name to Plural Industry Holding Group Co. Limited in June 2021. Plural Industry Holding Group Co. Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Oceanside, New York.
